mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the real final sales of domestic product (RSAFS) signals weakening aggregate demand, which historically precedes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of declining RSAFS are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
